title: Ligmastic
description: A mod that adds new elements to minecraft creative.
body:
Hello everyone this mod is an old classic. It adds cool new items for admins/players in creative. Such as the "God sword" which allows the player to kill anyone and anything even if the target is another creative mode player. This mod also features unobtainable items like the block of fire or the end portal block. 

Description of main items:
(none of them are craftable)
-The god sword: This item allows the player to kill anyone and anything even if the target is in creative mode
-The god pickaxe: A pickaxe that instantly mines any block (excluding bedrock) but doesn't drop any loot.
-The god breaker: Similar to the god pickaxe but you can select a radius ranging from 1 to 50. The god breaker will then mine 1-50 block per click.
-The instant bonemeal: Will instantly grow anything without any RNG.
-The in-air stone placer: Will place a stone block below the player.
-The fly ring: will allow the player to fly even in survival if the player has it in the inventory (it is currently a bit bugged so it sometimes keeps the effect even after being dropped)
-The invincibility ring: Will make the player INVINCIBLE even against the god sword. (same bug as fly ring)
-The minecart with spawner: A minecart that spawns pigs
